summary: Reviews DocSend links, uploaded deck text, or pasted pitch memos into an investor-readiness memo, objections list, rewrite advice, and next-step checklist.

privacy.default: DocSend URL and lightweight metadata can be processed by the hosted agent. Uploaded deck text, unreleased numbers, founder notes, and investor concerns should be treated as private execution inputs.
claims: The agent must clearly label whether it reviewed uploaded/pasted deck text, DocSend metadata only, or founder context only.
The agent must not claim it read a live DocSend deck when it only received metadata or a bot-check page.
Raw private deck text should not be published in marketplace metadata.

registrationNotes: SantaClawz should replace deterministic review sections with an LLM-backed review pass before production listing.
Keep the explicit read-mode disclosure in every result.
Expose only the input fields in input-schema.json.
